title: is_closed() branch at line 379 has no test coverage
description: The is_closed() guard in events.rs line 379 (inside the empty-batch path, when close_after_first=false) is unreachable in the single-threaded tokio test runtime. To exercise it, the coalescing task must: (1) wake via a broadcast arriving through rx.recv(), not via closed(), (2) filter the event to produce an empty batch, (3) then observe live_rx already dropped. In a single-threaded runtime the task cannot be mid-execution when live_rx is dropped — the select! closed() arm preempts this scenario every time. The branch exists for a valid production race but has zero test coverage. The fix attempt in the first test (events_coalescing_task_exits_on_disconnect_before_any_broadcast) does not actually exercise it.
